replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. My high neuroticism makes me worry about making mistakes, especially under time pressure. But since math is a favorite subject, I usually calm down by breaking problems into smaller, manageable parts. Practice helps, too!
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes! I used an AI tutor to practice algebra and calculus. It was great for instant feedback, but sometimes explanations were too rigid. I prefer combining it with human guidance. Still, it saved time and built my confidence.
